setup.turnHostsHint: Needed for the WebRTC video stream — comma-separate more than one (e.g. a LAN IP and a Tailscale IP) to support several access paths at once.
setup.publicWarning: Public access additionally needs UDP+TCP port 3478 (and the TURN relay range) forwarded on your router to this host, and may need this host's public IP set on the coturn service afterward if it's behind NAT. This wizard does not open ports or edit your router for you.
setup.applyNowHint: Restarts the backend for a few seconds to pick up the new address(es).
setup.instanceNameHint: Replaces "Browser Gateway" in the sidebar for everyone. Leave blank to keep the default.
setup.reviewIntro: Review before finishing — you can still go back and change anything.
setup.applyingNetwork: Applying network settings — the backend will restart briefly…
setup.networkFailed: Network apply failed — you can retry this later from Admin → Settings.

history.zipPasswordHint: Used when downloading session files as a password zip. Leave blank to keep.

steps.browserHint: Guest browser image for this session

browserDesc.chromium: Chromium with CDP and native DoH flags
browserDesc.firefox: Firefox ESR with TRR / DoH preferences

launch.networkEventLimitHint: How many DNS/HTTP events the Network panel keeps in view. Older events roll off past this count.

viewer.title: Remote browser
viewer.downloadsEmpty: No files in session Downloads yet.
viewer.treeEmpty: No HTTP requests to build a tree yet.
viewer.treeNoChildren: No child requests under this page.
viewer.webrtcComingSoon: WebRTC streaming is being reworked and is temporarily unavailable — noVNC is the active viewer for now.
viewer.netTaintFlagged: {{flagged}} of {{total}} domains seen in this session's traffic are on malicious/untrusted domain lists: {{domains}}
viewer.netTaintClean: No malicious domains found among {{total}} domains seen in this session's traffic.
viewer.streamDisabledHint: WebRTC and noVNC are turned off in admin settings.

admin.settingsSubtitle: Limits, TLS, updates and audit toggles — organized by section.
admin.settingsGeneralDesc: Session capacity and timeouts for the platform.
admin.settingsAppearanceDesc: Language, motion, theme, and session viewer controls.
admin.viewerHint: Show or hide toolbar components in the remote browser session page.
admin.viewerWebrtcHint: Allow switching to WebRTC viewing mode.
admin.viewerNovncHint: Allow switching to noVNC viewing mode.
admin.viewerFitHint: Scale remote desktop to fit the viewer.
admin.viewerStretchHint: Resize remote desktop to match the viewer.
admin.viewerClipboardHint: Paste local clipboard into the focused remote field, and copy from remote.
admin.viewerUploadHint: Upload files into the remote session.
admin.viewerDownloadsHint: List and save files from session Downloads.
admin.viewerNetworkHint: DNS / HTTP / TI network monitoring panel.
admin.pcapEnabledHint: Captures each session's traffic to a downloadable .pcap file via an isolated capture sidecar — the browser container itself never gets raw-socket access.
admin.pcapMaxMbHint: Capture stops automatically once a running session's file reaches this size; the session itself keeps running.
admin.settingsLoggingDesc: What activity is captured into the audit trail.
admin.settingsAdvancedHealthHint: TLS certificate status and system health live under Security → TLS.
admin.auditSubtitle: Human-readable activity log. Export RFC5424 for SIEM or archival.
admin.coming: Wired to admin API in Stage 8.
admin.dnsHint: Applies to new browser sessions. Both DNS IPs and DoH URL can be saved; the mode chooses what is used.
admin.dnsServersHintActive: Used as dnsmasq upstream for this mode.
admin.dnsServersHintIdle: Saved for later — active in Custom or Custom+DoH modes.
admin.dnsDohHintActive: Passed to Chromium as DNS-over-HTTPS template.
admin.dnsDohHintIdle: Saved for later — active in DoH or Custom+DoH modes.
admin.tiHint: Check session hosts against every TI source you enable below. Check runs all enabled providers in parallel.
admin.tiEnabledHint: Allow Check / enrich from the session Network panel.
admin.tiAutoEnrichHint: Lookup indicators from live netmon (rate-limited on free API keys).
admin.tiProvidersHint: Enable the sources to query on each Check. Leave API key blank to keep an existing key.
admin.tiVTHint: Domain / IP / URL reputation (API key required, free tier ~4/min).
admin.tiApiKeySetHint: Key is set. Leave blank to keep, or paste a new key to replace.
admin.tiUrlhausHint: Malware URL / host feed. No API key required.
admin.tiThreatfoxHint: IOC search for domain / IP / URL. Auth-Key optional but recommended.
admin.tiAbuseipdbHint: IP abuse confidence score (API key required). Skips non-IP indicators.
admin.tiOtxHint: Open Threat Exchange pulses for domain / IP / URL (API key required).
admin.tiSpamhausHint: ZEN (IP) and DBL (domain) via DNS. No API key. Needs outbound DNS from the host.
admin.tiCrtshHint: Certificate Transparency log history for a domain. No API key. Informational only, not counted toward the verdict.
admin.tiFeodoHint: abuse.ch botnet C2 IP blocklist. No API key. Checked against a locally cached copy refreshed hourly.
admin.tiShodanHint: Open ports, banners, and tags for a host (API key required). Informational only, not counted toward the verdict.
admin.tiSafebrowsingHint: Malware / phishing / unwanted-software checks (API key required).
admin.tiSafebrowsingKeyHint: API key from the Google Cloud Console (Safe Browsing API).
admin.tiMalwarebazaarHint: abuse.ch malware sample database, looked up by file hash (MD5/SHA1/SHA256). API key optional, raises the rate limit.
admin.tiCirclhashlookupHint: CIRCL's free known-file database (NSRL/vendor sets), looked up by file hash. No API key.
admin.tiFeedsHint: Free, no-key blocklists downloaded periodically and matched instantly from memory — enabled by default so domain/IP/hash checks and the end-of-session traffic summary work out of the box.
admin.tiFeedPhishingdbHint: Community-maintained active phishing domain list, updated frequently.
admin.tiFeedOpenphishHint: OpenPhish's free community phishing URL feed, refreshed hourly.
admin.tiFeedBlocklistprojectHint: Malware, phishing, ransomware, and scam domain lists.
admin.tiFeedHageziHint: Curated DNS blocklist (Pro tier) covering ads, tracking, and malicious domains.
admin.tiFeedIpsumHint: Multi-source aggregated malicious IP list, restricted to entries flagged by 3+ sources.
admin.tiFeedBlocklistdeHint: Abuse-reported IP addresses (brute force, scanning, spam).
admin.tiFeedSpamhausdropHint: Hijacked and malicious network ranges flagged by Spamhaus.
admin.tiFeedCinsarmyHint: Community-sourced list of IPs with poor reputation scores.
admin.tiFeedEtcompromisedHint: Proofpoint's list of known-compromised host IPs.
admin.tiFeedGreensnowHint: Attacking IP addresses collected from honeypots and community reports.
admin.healthHint: Live status of platform dependencies (postgres, redis, docker, traefik).
admin.tlsHint: Stored under /opt/browser-gateway/data/certs. Survives updates. SUPER_ADMIN only.
admin.tlsPending: Certificate saved. Traefik restart is pending.
admin.tlsBanner: TLS certificate was updated but Traefik was not restarted yet.
admin.updatesHint: Checks GitHub releases and main. Apply pulls main on the host and restarts via systemd.
admin.updatesForceHint: Pull main and rebuild even if the version check failed or reports up to date
admin.updatesForceConfirm: Force pull origin/main and rebuild? Use this if the version check cannot reach GitHub.
admin.updatesPending: Update already requested — waiting for host apply.
admin.updatesPendingStale: Previous update request is stale (host apply likely failed). Clear or retry.
admin.updatesConfirm: Pull latest code, rebuild images and restart the stack?
admin.updatesUnknownCommit: Installed revision unknown — Update now will pull the latest main.
admin.exportRfcHint: Machine-readable syslog/RFC5424 for SIEM or file archival

account.apiKeyUnsetHint: Using the project default key, if configured.
